TypeComment.summary: Represents an operand that is an address, in the form expr, expr,x, z:expr, or the expr, expr of a bit branch.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the z:, a:, f: or d: prefix, or null if the operand has none.
Gets the address.
Gets the , token, or null.
Gets the x, y or s register after the ,, or null.
Gets the second expression of a bit branch, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the a operand of an instruction such as asl a.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the a register.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a z:, a:, f: or d: prefix before an address.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the prefix's letter.
Gets the : token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents (a, b), the arguments of a call or of a macro call.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the ( token.
Gets the arguments. A call's arguments are expressions; a macro call's may also be braced operands and named arguments.
Gets the ) token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an .assert expr, "message" line, whose message may be omitted.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .assert keyword that starts the line.
Gets the condition being asserted.
Gets the , token before the level or the message, or null.
Gets a ca65 assertion level, which nt65 reports as an error, or null.
Gets the , token after ca65's level, or null.
Gets the quoted message, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one bank, such as $80, or a range of banks, such as $00..$3f.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the bank, or the first bank of the range.
Gets the .. token, or null.
Gets the last bank of the range, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a binary expression, left op right.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the left operand.
Gets the operator.
Gets the right operand.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a line that holds nothing, or nothing but a comment.
Represents a } on its own line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the } token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a } name { line, which closes one block argument of a macro call and opens the next.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the } token.
Gets the name of the parameter that receives the next block.
Gets the { token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a name on its own line, which splices a block parameter.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the name of the spliced parameter.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the single braced value of a counted or record data directive, on the directive's own line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the value, which is a or a .

TypeComment.summary: Represents a whole operand passed as a macro argument, such as {buf,x}.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the { token.
Gets the operand.
Gets the } token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a call, name(args) or .function(args).

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .func called, or null for a built-in function.
Gets the built-in function called, or null for a .func.
Gets the arguments.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a character in single quotes.
Represents a .charmap name { line.
Represents one entry of a .charmap, which maps a character, or a range of characters, to a value.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the character, or the first character of the range.
Gets the .. token, or null.
Gets the last character of the range, or null.
Gets the = token.
Gets the value the first character maps to.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a line that opens a branch with a condition, either .if expr { or } .elseif expr {.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .if or .elseif keyword.
Gets the condition under which the branch is taken.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .config NAME = value line, which declares a setting whose value the build may override.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .config keyword that starts the line.
Gets the setting's name.
Gets the = token.
Gets the setting's value.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a constant declaration, name = expr.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the constant's name.
Gets the = token.
Gets the constant's value.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .cpu name line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .cpu keyword that starts the line.
Gets the CPU's name.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a CPU name used where an expression is expected.
Represents *, the address of the statement that contains it.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the * token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the { of a data directive whose values are on the lines the brace opens.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the { token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .data name: element line, or a .data name { line for mixed data.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .data keyword that starts the line.
Gets the declared name.
Gets the : token before the data directive that describes the data, or null.
Gets the data directive that describes the data, or null.
Gets the { token that opens the block, or null if the source omits it.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a data directive, such as .byte 1, 2, .word[4] { … }, .type T { x = 1 } or .incbin "f".

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the directive.
Gets a value indicating whether the directive is .type, whose element is a named type.
Gets the T of .type T, or null.
Gets the [n] or [] after the element type, or null.
Gets the part that holds the values, which is a body this line opens, one braced value, or values on the line.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the part of a data directive that holds its values, which is the body the directive opens, one braced value, or the values on its line.
Represents one line of a data body, which holds comma-separated values of one element each.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the values, which are expressions and braced lists or records.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an .each what, name { line.
Represents an element count, [n], or [] for as many elements as there are values.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the [ token.
Gets the count, or null for [].
Gets the ] token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an [i] after a name, which selects the element of a counted declaration that the name refers to.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the [ token.
Gets the index of the element.
Gets the ] token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a } .else { line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the } token that closes the previous branch.
Gets the .else keyword.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a } .elseif expr { line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the } token that closes the previous branch.

TypeComment.summary: Represents {}, the default of a block parameter that a call may omit.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the { token.
Gets the } token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an .ensure a16, i8 line, which names the widths to establish at this point.
Represents an .enum name { line.
Represents one member of an .enum, which is a name, optionally followed by the value it is given.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the member's name.
Gets the = token, or null.
Gets the value the member is given, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an .error "message" or .warning "message" line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .error or .warning keyword that starts the line.
Gets the quoted message.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the place where an expression was expected and none could be read.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the directive that could not be read as a call of a built-in function, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a line that the parser could not read as any statement, holding its tokens unchanged.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the line's tokens, unchanged.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an .export line, such as .export a, outer::inner, K: abs, init as "_init", which lists names to export.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .export keyword that starts the line.
Gets the exported names.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one exported name, name or outer::inner, followed by an optional : size or as "linker_name".

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the exported name.
Gets the : token before the address size, or null.
Gets the zp, abs or far keyword after the :, or null.
Gets the as keyword before the linker name, or null.
Gets the quoted name the linker sees, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an expression.
Represents a .proc name = address: entry -> exit line, which declares a routine with no body.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .proc keyword that starts the line.
Gets the routine's name.
Gets the = token.
Gets the routine's address.
Gets the signature, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .fallthrough next line. It is the last line of a routine's body, and it names the routine that every path reaching the end runs into.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .fallthrough keyword that starts the line.
Gets the routine that execution runs into, or null if the source omits the name.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .frame locals: Locals line, which declares a name and the struct that gives the layout of the top of the stack.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .frame keyword that starts the line.
Gets the frame's name.
Gets the : token before the struct.
Gets the struct that gives the frame's layout, or null if the source omits even the :.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .func name(a, b) = expr line, which declares a pure expression function.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .func keyword that starts the line.
Gets the function's name.
Gets the parameters, or null if the source omits even the (.
Gets the = token before the body.
Gets the expression the function stands for.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one name, with the [i] after it if it has one. It serves as a part of a path, a parameter's word or a register.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the name.
Gets the [i] after the name, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an .if expr { line.
Represents an immediate operand, #expr, or the #src, #dst of a block move.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the # token.
Gets the value.
Gets the , token before a second value, or null.
Gets the # token of a second value, or null.
Gets the second bank of a block move, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an .import line, such as .import a, b: far, c: proc(a8 -> a8).

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .import keyword that starts the line.
Gets the imported names.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one imported name, in the form name, name: size, name: proc(...) or a checked name = expr.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the imported name.
Gets the = token before a checked value, or null.
Gets the value the import is checked against, or null.
Gets the : token before a size or a signature, or null.
Gets the zp, abs or far keyword after the :, or null.
Gets the proc(...) after the :, or null.
Gets the element type after the :, such as .byte[16] or .type T, or null.
Gets the in keyword before the segment the imported name is in, or null.
Gets the segment the imported name is in, after in, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents proc(entry -> exit), the signature of an imported routine.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the proc keyword.
Gets the ( token.
Gets the state on entry, or null if the source omits it.
Gets the -> token, or null.
Gets the state on exit, or null if the source omits it.
Gets the ) token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an indexed indirect operand, (expr,x) or (expr,s),y.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the ( token.
Gets the address of the pointer.
Gets the , token inside the parentheses.
Gets the x or s register inside the parentheses.
Gets the ) token.
Gets the , token after the parentheses, or null.
Gets the y register after the parentheses, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an indirect operand, (expr) or (expr),y.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the ( token.
Gets the address of the pointer.
Gets the ) token.
Gets the , token before the index register, or null.
Gets the y register after the parentheses, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the values of a data directive that appear on the directive's own line, after the element type.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the values.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an instruction, which is a mnemonic and its operand, if it takes one.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the mnemonic.
Gets the operand, or null if the instruction has none.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a label, name:, at the start of a line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the label's name.
Gets the : token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a label and the instruction, data directive or macro call that follows it, if any.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the label.
Gets the statement that follows the label, or null if there is none.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .list name { line.
Represents one line of a .list, which holds one or more comma-separated items.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the items.

TypeComment.summary: Represents an expression that consists of one token.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the expression's single token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a long indirect operand, [expr] or [expr],y.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the [ token.
Gets the address of the pointer.
Gets the ] token.
Gets the , token before the index register, or null.
Gets the y register after the brackets, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a macro call, name!(args), with the { of a trailing block argument if one follows.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the macro's name, which may be an instruction's name.
Gets the ! token.
Gets the arguments, or null if the source omits even the (.
Gets the { token that opens the block, or null if the source omits it.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .macro name(params): entry -> exit { line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .macro keyword that starts the line.
Gets the macro's name.
Gets the parameters, or null if the source omits even the (.
Gets the processor state the macro expects and leaves, or null.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents (a, b: expr, c = 1), the parameters of a macro.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the ( token.
Gets the parameters.
Gets the ) token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one macro parameter, in the form name, name: kind, name = default or all three.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the parameter's name.
Gets the : token before the kind, or null.
Gets what the parameter takes, or null.
Gets the = token before the default, or null.
Gets the default, which is an expression or the {} of a block parameter, or null if there is none.

TypeComment.summary: Represents member = value, either in a braced record or on its own line in a multi-line initializer.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the member's name.
Gets the = token.
Gets the value, which is an expression or a braced list or record.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .module name or .module outer::inner line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .module keyword that starts the line.
Gets the module's name, which is a path from the root of the module hierarchy.
Gets the : token before the marker that says whether the module may be placed, or null.
Gets the placed or placeable keyword after the :, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .multiproc E, b: signature { line, which declares one routine per member of the enum E.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .multiproc keyword that starts the line.
Gets the enum whose members the routines are named from.
Gets the , token before the name.
Gets the name bound to the member.
Gets the signature, or null.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a name, such as label, @local, gfx::init, ::top_level or table[2]::x.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the leading :: token of a name that starts from the top level, or null.

Gets the names between the :: tokens, outermost first, each with the [i] after it. There is always at least one, because a part the source omits appears in the list as an IdentifierName whose name is missing.

TypeComment.summary: Represents name = argument, a macro argument given by name.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the parameter's name.
Gets the = token.
Gets the argument given to the parameter.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .next @a, gfx::init or .next ? line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .next keyword that starts the line.
Gets the ? token of .next ?, or null.
Gets the labels where execution continues.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a number.
Represents an instruction's operand. Layout decides which forms an instruction and a CPU allow.

Represents what a macro parameter takes. It is a fixed word, a one(...) of listed words, a list(...) of one of the other kinds, a const(0..15) in a range, an operand(imm, zp) in the listed modes, or the name of an enum whose members the parameter takes.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the kind's word, or null if the kind is an enum's name.
Gets the enum whose members the parameter takes, or null if the kind is a word.
Gets the ( token of a one, a list, a const range or an operand's modes, or null.
Gets the words that a one(...) accepts, or the modes that an operand(...) accepts.
Gets the kind of each item of a list(...), or null.
Gets the lowest value a const(...) accepts, or null.
Gets the .. token of a const(...) range, or null.
Gets the highest value a const(...) accepts, or null.
Gets the ) token, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents (a, b), the parameters of a .func.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the ( token.
Gets the parameters.
Gets the ) token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one parameter of a .func, which is only its name.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the parameter's name.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a parenthesized expression, (expr).

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the ( token.
Gets the expression in the parentheses.
Gets the ) token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .patch @op line, which names the instruction whose bytes the store above it overwrites.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .patch keyword that starts the line.
Gets the label of the instruction that is overwritten, or null if the source omits the name.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .place name line, which emits another module's bytes where the line stands.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .place keyword that starts the line.
Gets the name of the module to place, as a path from the root of the module hierarchy.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .proc name: entry -> exit { line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .proc keyword that starts the line.
Gets the routine's name.
Gets the signature, or null.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the : entry -> exit signature of a proc, an extern proc or a macro.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the : token.
Gets the state on entry.
Gets the -> token, or null.
Gets the state on exit, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents { member = value, … }, the values of a record.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the { token.
Gets the members that are given a value.
Gets the } token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .repeat count, name { line.
Represents the line that opens a repetition, either .repeat count, name { or .each what, name {.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .repeat or .each keyword that starts the line.
Gets the count of a .repeat, or what an .each iterates over.
Gets the , token before the name, or null.
Gets the name bound to the index or the item, or null if the source omits it.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .scope name { line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .scope keyword that starts the line.
Gets the scope's name, or null for an anonymous scope.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a segment attribute, which is dp = expr, bank = expr, space = expr or mirrors = [$00..$3f, $80..$bf].

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the dp, bank, space or mirrors keyword.
Gets the = token.
Gets the value of a dp, a bank or a space, or null.
Gets the [ token of a mirrors, or null.
Gets the banks of a mirrors.
Gets the ] token of a mirrors, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .segment NAME { line, which opens a segment block.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .segment NAME: size line, with its attributes.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the : token before the address size.
Gets the zp, abs or far keyword.
Gets the , token between the address size and the attributes, or null.
Gets the attributes after the address size.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .segment NAME region line, which puts the lines that follow it in the segment.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets a { token that follows the name on a line that opens no block, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a line that starts with .segment, which is a declaration, the opening line of a block, or a region line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .segment keyword that starts the line.
Gets the segment's name. A quoted name is an error, but it is still the name.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .signature std = a8, i16, dp = 0 line, which names a set of items that signatures can use.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .signature keyword that starts the line.
Gets the set's name.
Gets the = token before the items.
Gets the items the name stands for, or null if the source omits even the =.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the tokens left on a line after its statement, which the parser skipped.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the tokens the parser skipped.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .state a16, i8 line, whose signature items are asserted and set at one point in the code.
Represents a state word and the * or ? after it, such as a16, i* or e?.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the item's word.
Gets the * or ? token after the word, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents inline .strz, which states that the data after each call is a zero-terminated string.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the inline keyword.
Gets the .strz keyword.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one processor-state item, such as a16, i*, dp = 0, dbr = [$00..$3f], args 2, inline .strz, keeps a, x, ? on its own, or the name of a signature set.
Represents a state word and the set of banks its register lies in, such as dbr = [$00..$3f, $80..$bf].

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the item's word.
Gets the = token.
Gets the [ token.
Gets the banks, each a single bank or a range of banks.
Gets the ] token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents keeps a, x, which lists the registers a routine leaves as it found them.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the keeps keyword.
Gets the registers the routine keeps.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a directive that takes the items of a signature, either .state or .ensure.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .state or .ensure keyword that starts the line.
Gets the items.

TypeComment.summary: Represents processor-state items separated by commas.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the items.

TypeComment.summary: Represents the name of a signature set, which stands for the items the set was declared with.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the set's name.

TypeComment.summary: Represents ? on its own, which states that every tracked part of the processor state is unknown.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the ? token.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a state word and the value it is given, such as dp = $2100, args 2 or inline 4.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the item's word.
Gets the = token before the value, or null for a word that takes its value without one.
Gets the value.

TypeComment.summary: Represents what a line's tokens parse to, such as a declaration, a directive, an instruction or a member of a body. A few statements also appear inside another statement, as an instruction does after a label and a data directive does after .data name:. Wherever it appears, a statement holds only its own tokens. The line break, any tokens the statement could not take, and the .export before a declaration all belong to the line ().

PropertyComment.summary: Gets a value indicating whether this is a declaration that follows .export.
Gets the .export keyword that precedes this declaration on its line, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a string in double quotes.
Represents a .struct name { line.
Represents the line that opens an .enum, .struct, .union, .charmap or .list.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .enum, .struct or similar keyword that starts the line.
Gets the declared name, or null for an anonymous declaration.
Gets the { token that opens the block.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a unary expression, op operand.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the operator.
Gets the operand the operator applies to.

TypeComment.summary: Represents a .union name { line.
Represents a .use a::b, .use a::{b, c as d}, .use a::* or .use a::b as c line.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the .use keyword that starts the line.
Gets the path, outermost name first, which is everything before a ::*, a ::{ or an as.
Gets the :: token before a * or a {, or null.
Gets the * token of a::*, or null.
Gets the { token of a::{b, c}, or null.
Gets the names in the braces of a::{b, c}.
Gets the } token of a::{b, c}. It is missing if the { is present and the source does not reach the }, and it is null for a line that has no braces.
Gets the as keyword of a::b as c, or null.
Gets the name that the path's last name is brought in as, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents one name in the braces of a .use, and the name it is brought in as.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the name that is brought in.
Gets the as keyword, or null.
Gets the name it is brought in as, or null.

TypeComment.summary: Represents { value, … }, a list of elements.

PropertyComment.summary: Gets the { token.
Gets the values, which are expressions and braced lists or records.
Gets the } token.
